name: kubeflow-platform
description: One authenticated, multi-user home for your Kubeflow apps - reuses NKP login (Dex) and provisions dedicated kubeflow gateway pods with a dedicated LoadBalancer. You must set config.kubeflowIngressHost (DNS name or IP) in app config when enabling.
overview:
**What it is** — Kubeflow Platform is the glue that turns Central Dashboard
and Pipelines into **one website with one login and per-user workspaces**.
Auth is **Istio + NKP Dex + oauth2-proxy**. oauth2-proxy sits inline on the dedicated Kubeflow gateway and
injects `kubeflow-userid` / `kubeflow-groups`.

**What you get**
- **One URL, one login.** A single entry point that authenticates every user
  against **your existing NKP login (Dex)** - no second identity system, no
  extra passwords.
- **Dedicated Kubeflow ingress address.** The app provisions dedicated Istio
  gateway pods (`kubeflow-ingressgateway`) and a separate LoadBalancer
  Service, so Kubeflow does not share NKP console / Traefik routes.
- **Per-user workspaces.** Each user gets their own isolated namespace with the
  right permissions, so teammates don't see or touch each other's work.
- **Component UIs under one host.** Dashboard at `/`, Pipelines at
  `/pipeline/`.

**Operator action required** — Set `config.kubeflowIngressHost` (and
optionally `config.kubeflowIngressURL`) in app config before or when
enabling. Do not enable with an empty host. Then enable Central Dashboard
and Pipelines so their baked VirtualServices can reach oauth2-proxy.

Set this in the app configuration (Kommander UI → Configuration, or `configOverrides`):

```yaml
config:
  # DNS name or IP the browser will open (no http://). Required.
  kubeflowIngressHost: "10.22.203.228"
  # optional; defaults to http://<kubeflowIngressHost>
  kubeflowIngressURL: ""
  userIDClaim: email
```

Use a hostname (for example `kubeflow.example.com`) if you have one. After the LoadBalancer exists,
point that DNS at the service.


**Onboard users from the UI** — Add a user by listing them under `profiles`
in this app's configuration. `owner` must equal the Dex claim in
`config.userIDClaim` (email by default). Each entry creates that user's
private workspace. No `kubectl` required.

**Before you enable**
- Set `config.kubeflowIngressHost` (required) and optional `config.kubeflowIngressURL`.
- **istio-helm** (required) — Istio revision for the dedicated gateway pods.
  Enable it from the workspace catalog. NKP Dex is already on the management
  plane (same login as the console); there is no Dex app to enable.
- Enable **Central Dashboard** and **Pipelines** after Platform. Their
  charts expect this app's oauth2-proxy; port-forward skips login.

**Resources** — [Kubeflow Profiles](https://www.kubeflow.org/docs/components/central-dash/profiles/) |
[oauth2-proxy](https://oauth2-proxy.github.io/oauth2-proxy/)
